hints.title: Grammar Rules for Decimal and Integer Tokens
hints.text: Parse string tracking whether digits, an exponent indicator, signs, or decimal dots have appeared and where they are permitted.

hints.title: Strict Exponent and Sign Placement Constraints
hints.text: A sign can only appear at the start or immediately after an exponent symbol. A decimal point cannot appear after an exponent symbol.

hints.title: Sequential Character Validation
hints.text: Iterate through the string maintaining boolean flags for seen digit, seen exponent, and seen dot. A dot is invalid if another dot or exponent already occurred. An exponent is invalid if no digit preceded it or an exponent was already seen. Ensure at least one digit is seen and any exponent is followed by digits.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regular expressions can produce pathological backtracking on malformed input.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Flag-based deterministic inspection avoids state table memory overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean handling of exponent digit requirements, sign positioning, and isolated dots.
